messages:
kai: Pushed a quick prototype to the playground — inline parameter examples in the schema editor + a compact preview in run history. Would love eyes on accessibility and copy.

sam: Nice, looks promising. Quick q: where do the examples come from? Manual entries or auto-generated?

kai: Manual for the prototype (dev-entered). Long-term idea is auto-suggest from eval sets / common prompts but for this PR please focus on placement, affordances, and labels.

tess: UI looks tidy. Two quick nits: (1) the 'Add example' button hover is low contrast, hard to spot; (2) the keyboard shortcut hint (Cmd+E) isn't exposed to screen readers.

anna: Strong +1 on contrast. Recommendation: use the primary token color for the hover bg, and add aria-describedby to the shortcut hint so VO reads it. Also propose copy change: 'Add example' -> 'Add parameter example' — clearer in run history.

sam: For the run history, can we collapse examples under a disclosure chevron? When there are many calls the list becomes noisy.

kai: I added a compact row that shows a collapsed 'examples' pill with a count (e.g., "Examples (3)"). Click expands inline to reveal the examples. Thinking subtle height animation.

anna: Keep the animation short (150ms) and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Important: chevron needs aria-expanded and role="button" with keyboard handlers.

bot-deploy: deploy succeeded: playground-schema-preview-1717500000 deployed to staging :white_check_mark: 

tess: Tiny copy nit in run history: 'View examples' -> 'Show examples (3)' reads better to me. Also, when expanding the list keyboard focus jumps — focus should land on the first example or a skip-link.

kai: Good call. I'll change label to 'Show examples (n)' and programmatically move focus to the first interactive element inside the expanded region. Adding a 'Skip to examples' anchor for keyboard users too.

sam: Proposed a11y test plan: NVDA + VoiceOver passes, keyboard-only navigation, and a quick Chromium accessibility tree check. I'll run this tomorrow morning and report issues.

anna: I'll draft microcopy suggestions in a gist (short labels, tooltip strings, and error states for empty examples). Also will attach hover/focus screenshots and the color tokens we should use.

kai: Thanks everyone — merging in ~1h unless more blockers. If you want another pass before merge ping me here or DM. :thumbsup:
